title: insilico-clinval: end-to-end in silico validation and regression testing of clinical genome sequencing pipelines
description:
End-to-end in silico framework for truth-based validation and regression testing of clinical genome sequencing pipelines, from simulated reads to reportable findings. It selects test variants, writes a phased truth VCF with expected-outcome metadata, simulates reads with Mason, runs the secondary and tertiary analysis through adapters, compares the findings with the truth and assigns every failure to a pipeline stage.
